tools.name: find_fax_number
tools.description: Finds the fax number of the IRS office that takes a form or a notice, from XipFax’s list of offices, read from the IRS’s own pages. Give the form or the notice by its name or number alone, such as Form 2848, SS-4 or CP2000. Where the IRS gives a number for each state, give the place too.

tools.name: quote_fax
tools.description: The price of sending one fax of a number of pages with XipFax, without a plan, from XipFax’s price list.

tools.name: send_fax_link
tools.description: A link that opens XipFax’s send screen with the fax number filled in: an office by its office_id from find_fax_number, or a fax number in the United States, its territories or Canada. The person adds their pages there, signs in and pays.
